2The 'birds are dinosaurs' theory was first developed by English palaeontologist Thomas Huxley (1825–1895). According to some accounts, one evening Huxley went to dinner still thinking about a mystery dinosaur bone in his lab. He knew he was dealing with the lower leg bone (tibia) of a meat-eating, two-legged dinosaur belonging to the classification known as theropods, but attached to the tibia was an unidentified extra bone. On the menu that evening was quail, a small bird similar to a pheasant, and Huxley noticed the same strange bone, attached to the quail tibia on his plate. He later realised that it was in fact the bird's anklebone. More importantly, Huxley concluded that its forms in both dinosaur and bird skeletons were so similar that they must be closely related.

3Huxley's idea fell out of favour for fifty years following the 1916 publication of The Origin of Birds by the Danish doctor Gerhard Heilmann. During this time, Heilmann’s theory was widely accepted. Heilmann had noted that two-legged, meat-eating dinosaurs lacked collarbones. In later evolutionary stages these bones fuse together to form the distinctive 'Y'-shaped bone in a bird's neck, known as the furcula. Heilmann proposed the notion that such a feature could not be lost and then re-evolve at a later date, so dinosaurs could not be the ancestors of birds.

4Then, in the late 1960s, John Ostrom from Yale University in the USA, noted 22 features in the skeletons of meat-eating dinosaurs that were also found in birds and nowhere else. This reset the thinking on bird ancestry and once again Huxley’s ideas caught the attention of the scientific community. Subsequent work has found up to 85 characteristics that tie dinosaurs and birds together. But what of Heilmann's missing bones? It turns out that not only did many dinosaurs have collarbones, these were also fused together into a furcula. Unfortunately for Heilmann, the fossil evidence was somewhat lacking in his day, and the few furculae that had been found were misidentified, usually as belly ribs.

According to some accounts, one evening Huxley went to dinner still thinking about a mystery dinosaur bone in his lab. He knew he was dealing with the lower leg bone (tibia) of a meat-eating, two-legged dinosaur belonging to the classification known as theropods, but attached to the tibia was an unidentified extra bone. On the menu that evening was quail, a small bird similar to a pheasant, and Huxley noticed the same strange bone, attached to the quail tibia on his plate. He later realised that it was in fact the bird's anklebone. More importantly, Huxley concluded that its forms in both dinosaur and bird skeletons were so similar that they must be closely related.

第2段叙述赫胥黎从恐龙腿骨与鹌鹑骨骼的相似处受到启发，并把额外骨骼认作踝骨。According to some accounts把晚餐故事标为一些记载中的说法。他据两类骨骼形态相近推断关系密切，段落重点是比较解剖结构怎样促成一个解释。

Huxley's idea fell out of favour for fifty years following the 1916 publication of The Origin of Birds by the Danish doctor Gerhard Heilmann. During this time, Heilmann’s theory was widely accepted. Heilmann had noted that two-legged, meat-eating dinosaurs lacked collarbones. In later evolutionary stages these bones fuse together to form the distinctive 'Y'-shaped bone in a bird's neck, known as the furcula. Heilmann proposed the notion that such a feature could not be lost and then re-evolve at a later date, so dinosaurs could not be the ancestors of birds.

第3段交代赫胥黎的观点为何一度失去支持：海尔曼认为某类恐龙没有锁骨，又认为这种特征不可能消失后再次演化出现，于是排除了它们作为鸟类祖先的可能。这里是在解释他的论证前提，不是在把“恐龙没有锁骨”继续当作事实。

4

Then, in the late 1960s, John Ostrom from Yale University in the USA, noted 22 features in the skeletons of meat-eating dinosaurs that were also found in birds and nowhere else. This reset the thinking on bird ancestry and once again Huxley’s ideas caught the attention of the scientific community. Subsequent work has found up to 85 characteristics that tie dinosaurs and birds together. But what of Heilmann's missing bones? It turns out that not only did many dinosaurs have collarbones, these were also fused together into a furcula. Unfortunately for Heilmann, the fossil evidence was somewhat lacking in his day, and the few furculae that had been found were misidentified, usually as belly ribs.

第4段呈现后来对共同特征的重新识别，以及更多相关骨骼证据。缺失锁骨的问题被重新解释为当时化石不足、已发现标本遭到误认。up to 85表示后续工作记录的数量上限式表述，不是说每种恐龙与每种鸟都有完全相同的85项特征。

The trouble is that we will never be able to experience any animal's dreams. That goes for other humans' dreams too. But we can try to imagine what these dreamscapes are like by meeting animals on their own terms. For example, vision is the dominant sense for many humans, and so our dreams are heavily visual too. Dogs primarily navigate the world using smell while spiders rely much more on vibrations.

作者承认，人无法直接进入其他动物甚至其他人的梦，但可以从物种自己的感官特点出发想象其体验。人类多依赖视觉，狗依赖嗅觉，蜘蛛较依赖振动，因此不能把所有动物的梦都想成一段人类式视觉电影。on their own terms要求尊重不同物种的生活方式。

原文第10段

It is likely that dreaming has served multiple purposes since the first complex animals evolved. And if this is the case, it is possible that better understanding of these purposes might shed light on the true purpose of our own dreams.

结尾提出，梦自复杂动物演化以来可能承担了多种功能；如果如此，更好地理解这些功能也许能帮助理解人类的梦。likely、if、possible和might层层保留条件，作者以开放的研究方向收尾，而没有给出唯一且最终的梦的用途。

词语与搭配

forming memories and learning

形成记忆与学习

两个动名词并列，说明研究讨论的功能；本段说证据逐渐支持相关作用，并未给出适用于所有物种的统一机制。

integrate memories into longer-term storage

把记忆整合进较长期的储存

integrate...into...表示并入某个系统或结构，longer-term是相对较长期，并非永不遗忘。

as well as outward behaviour

除了外在行为以外

as well as在此补充另一类所需证据，后面提出脑成像；不是说行为观察毫无价值。

on their own terms

从它们自身的条件和生活方式出发

their指动物，强调不要只套用人类的感官经验；此处不是交易或谈判中的条款。

shed light on

帮助解释、增进对……的理解

这是照亮的比喻，常用于研究贡献；比prove更克制，不表示一次研究已经解决全部问题。

句子精读

He argues that as well as outward behaviour, brain imaging is needed to show that the octopuses are replaying sequences of activities from their waking lives in dreams.

他认为，除了外在行为，还需要脑成像来显示章鱼是否在梦中重演清醒生活中的一连串活动。

He指Scheel；argues that标明这是他的研究判断。主句内容是brain imaging is needed，as well as...补充已有的行为证据。to show说明成像的目的，后面的that从句是待支持的解释；from their waking lives修饰activities，与in dreams形成清醒经历和梦中重演的关系。原文并不是说成像证据已经取得。

And if this is the case, it is possible that better understanding of these purposes might shed light on the true purpose of our own dreams.

如果情况确实如此，那么更好地理解这些功能，或许能帮助我们理解自身梦境的真正用途。

this is the case回指上一句梦可能自复杂动物出现以来承担多种功能。it是形式主语，that从句给出真正内容；better understanding是该从句主语，these purposes指梦的多种功能。if、possible、might共同保留条件和不确定性，不能把整句改述为研究已经确定人类做梦的目的。
